# Official ModelSpend Community releases

This is the **public distribution repository** for free, self-hosted ModelSpend Core. Application development occurs in a separate private canonical repository. **This repository does not publish application source code.**

## Current availability

**No verified public Core release has been announced here yet.** A GitHub source archive or a checkout of this repository is **not** an installable ModelSpend application. Do not use tags, autogenerated GitHub source archives or third-party builds as official installation media.

When an official release is available, its release page will explicitly identify the supported installation artifact and deployment prerequisites.

## What an official release must contain

- A versioned Core-only container or installable package, with immutable digest/checksum
- Installation, upgrade and rollback instructions suited to the actual shipped artifact
- A release manifest identifying the official version, compatibility and build provenance
- Software bill of materials (SBOM) and applicable third-party notices
- Independent validation evidence for core boot, routing, authentication, tenant isolation and privacy boundaries
- Evidence that no commercial plugin implementation, private source, secrets, debug artifacts or sensitive source maps are distributed
- An explicit approved proprietary freeware licence and any required redistribution notices

All downloads must originate from an official release published by authorised ModelSpend maintainers. Third-party binaries are not endorsed.

## Commercial extensions

Premium plugins and managed/cloud hosting are separately licensed. Paid plugin implementation code is **not** part of the free Core distribution. The Core may describe premium features without shipping their code.

## Release integrity and support

Before installing, compare the downloaded asset's published checksum/digest with the release manifest. Never install an asset when the official integrity information or applicable licence is missing.

The free self-hosted Core does not automatically include a commercial support agreement. See [the ModelSpend website](https://modelspend.best) for supported offerings.

For vulnerabilities, follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
